D Dhanush

(cid:263) dhanushdevaraj17@gmail.com | (cid:294) 9380249870 (cid:93) https://www.linkedin.com/in/d-dhanush-a733521b3/ | (cid:97) https://github.com/ddhanushd

Skills Languages: Java (Java 11+), Python, JavaScript, SQL

Frameworks & Libraries: Core Java, Spring Boot, Spring, Hibernate, JPA, JUnit, Mockito, Angular

Databases & Tools: MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Docker, AWS, Maven, Git, GitHub, Postman, Swagger

Other: Microservices, REST APIs, HTML/CSS, AI Integration (LLMs, Ollama), SOLID Principles, Design Patterns

Work Experience Software Engineer | CitiusTech Health Technologies Pvt. Ltd., Bangalore

July 2022 – September 2023 • Developed and maintained RESTful APIs using Spring Boot, enhancing application functionality and boosting

performance by 30%.

Designed Microservices architecture, boosting scalability by 40% and optimizing resource allocation, while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

Integrated software components, resolving critical bugs and reducing downtime by 25%, improving system stability and development efficiency.

Freelance Java Developer | Independent Projects

October 2023 – Present • Built scalable microservices with Spring Boot & Spring Security (JWT, Okta OAuth2), and containerized applications

using Docker for deployment on AWS, reducing deployment effort by 30%.

Engineered a PDF Q&A pipeline with chunk extraction, embedding storage in DB, and integrated Ollama LLM for AI-driven responses, improving retrieval accuracy by 25%.

Explored performance enhancements by integrating Redis caching into full-stack apps with Angular & JavaScript, accelerating response speed by 20%.

Project Work 1. Healthcare Patient Management System

Crafted a microservices-based system for managing patient data and appointments for 10,000+ patients, optimizing MySQL and PostgreSQL queries for enhanced performance.

Collaborated with senior engineers to improve system scalability and reduce processing time by 25%, ensuring smooth integration during QA/UAT phases.

Resolved production issues, minimizing system downtime by 15% and maintaining stable performance.

2. Hotel Rating Microservices Application

Architected a microservices-based solution for core services (User, Rating, Hotel), improving scalability by 40% and reducing communication latency by 30% through REST APIs, Feign Client, and Spring Cloud API Gateway.

Deployed Eureka Server for service discovery and implemented Circuit Breaker patterns, ensuring 99.9% uptime and enhancing system reliability by 25%.

Secured microservices with OAuth2 and Okta, optimizing performance with Redis caching and improving response times by 25%.

3. Stock Market Investing Application

Constructed a Spring Boot application to manage stock portfolios for 500+ users. • Architected JWT authentication and created RESTful APIs for CRUD operations, handling 100+ requests daily. • Leveraged JPA to optimize database interactions, ensuring data integrity and reducing errors by 30%.

Education B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering M S Ramaiah Institute of Technology

August 2018 – July 2022 CGPA: 7.85/10

Intermediate (PUC) – Science Sarvodaya PU College

June 2016 – May 2018 Percentage: 89.83%

Certifications

Java Backend: Spring Core, Spring MVC, Spring Boot, Spring JPA and REST, and Docker on Pluralsight Bootcamp and Certification badge.

• MongoDB Developer’s Toolkit: CRUD Mastery with Java on GeeksforGeeks. • Java (Basic) on HackerRank.
